meaning:
ἐξ-υπνίζω
[in LXX: Jdg.16:14, 20, 3Ki.3:13 (יָקַץ), Job.14:12 (עוּר ni.)* ;]
to awaken out of sleep (= ἀφυπνίζω): with accusative of person(s), Jhn.11:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
